findings.title: All chain authority remains concentrated on one Trezor Model T
evidence: The owner explicitly rejected separate authorities and required all chain authorities to remain on the sole Trezor Model T
No multisig, second hardware authority, hot key, server key, or alternate authority address was introduced
Hardware isolation protects key material but is not administrative role separation
residualRisk: One device, seed, or operator compromise can correlate otherwise distinct administrative powers
Device loss or seed loss can create a single recovery and continuity failure
Owner acceptance does not convert this risk into an independent security control
containment: Keep signing attended, offline-first, human-reviewed, and source/evidence bound
Never permit server-side or automatic signing or broadcast
Preserve Mainnet HOLD until all non-authority launch blockers close

findings.title: The hardened source has not received independent final-code review
evidence: This package is an internal Codex-assisted review
The earlier FDF Guard sign-off binds a prior source and binary
remediation: Obtain independent review of commit b73d2d3ce8572e833b9fdd37df23cd97b40df111 or its exact successor
Compare source, build, evidence, program accounts, and transaction hashes before any clearance

findings.title: No signed Devnet rehearsal covers the hardened source and current SBF
evidence: A pinned verifiable build produced a 579,480-byte SBF with SHA-256 d437be9a78aeaa09eeef419554bd0c0598a18239edeb226912c79a973f24d2a4 for b73d2d3
The current local proof is deterministic host evidence and uses no validator transaction, signer, wallet, or broadcast
The earlier 29 finalized Devnet signatures remain historical only
remediation: Run the complete signed Devnet rehearsal on that exact binary
Publish finalized receipts and obtain independent comparison

findings.title: Production X OAuth and Cloudflare D1 transaction behavior needs integration rehearsal
evidence: Source and SQLite-model tests cover nonce consumption, Premium and age gates, final-slot contention, and rollback predicates
No production X OAuth or Cloudflare D1 request was made in this review
remediation: Exercise test-environment OAuth callback, D1 batch rollback, retry, duplicate, timeout, and 1,000th-slot concurrency cases
Retain redacted receipts without tokens, cookies, client secrets, or personal data

findings.title: X Premium and account-age decisions depend on an external provider trust boundary
evidence: Eligibility is bound to the immutable X user ID, subscription_type, and created_at fields returned by X
Premium is revalidated within 24 hours and account age is checked at the inclusive exact 40-day boundary
These controls raise Sybil cost but do not prove one biological person or prevent all purchased or compromised accounts
remediation: Monitor provider schema and subscription semantics
Fail closed on missing, malformed, stale, downgraded, or contradictory identity evidence
Publish aggregate outcomes without exposing private identity data

findings.title: Site development toolchain retains upstream dependency advisories
evidence: The site production dependency audit reports zero vulnerabilities
The full development graph reports 22 upstream advisories through current Solana, Next, Drizzle, sharp, esbuild, postcss, uuid, and bigint-buffer chains
A normal audit fix made no change; force remediation proposed unsafe major downgrades and was rejected
remediation: Track upstream fixed releases and retest lockfile changes
Keep development dependencies out of the production runtime and deployment image

findings.title: Eight pre-existing unoptimized image lint warnings remain
evidence: ESLint reports zero errors and eight next/no-img-element warnings
remediation: Migrate eligible static images to the reviewed optimization path after launch-security work

findings.title: Genesis node activation no longer trusts a returned UUID as bearer authority
evidence: Wallet proof creates a short-lived signed HttpOnly Secure host cookie bound to node, wallet, nonce, and expiry
Country selection and X authorization require the bound session and same-origin request
OAuth state is one-time and callback activation is bound to the immutable X user ID

findings.title: Genesis identity and final-slot accounting are fail-closed
evidence: Wallet and immutable X user ID are independently unique
Only Premium or PremiumPlus accounts at least 40 days old qualify
The atomic D1 batch reserves exactly one of 1,000 numbered slots and activates the binding or rolls back

findings.title: Daily reward liability and oversubscription are deterministic and bounded
evidence: At most 1,000 winners receive 12 IAT each per UTC epoch
The exact maximum is 12,000 IAT per epoch and 4,380,000 IAT over 365 epochs
Selection rejects duplicate wallet or immutable X identity and stale, young, or non-Premium evidence

findings.title: CCC future-DLC instructions are compiled fail-closed for Genesis
evidence: Every CCC registry, eligibility, position, randomness, round, and settlement path returns CccDlcNotActive
No activation instruction exists in the Genesis program
Enabling CCC requires a separately reviewed future program upgrade

findings.title: Public RPC and desktop overlay boundaries are constrained
evidence: The public RPC proxy is read-only, request and response bounded, timed out, rate limited in D1, and does not disclose a custom endpoint hostname
The desktop renderer is sandboxed, navigation and popups are denied, permissions are exact-origin, and capture requires the trusted main frame plus user gesture

findings.title: Production dependency graphs and root build tooling are clean under the pinned runtime
evidence: Root production and full dependency audits report zero vulnerabilities
Site production dependency audit reports zero vulnerabilities
Node 24.14.0 is used for validation and package-manager versions are pinned
